title: See all of my WhatsApp groups

messages.content: Can you see all of my WhatsApp groups?

No — I don't have a tool to enumerate your WhatsApp groups. I can interact with groups (send messages, reply, react) but only if you give me the group's JID (the `...@g.us` ID). I can't browse through them or discover them on my own.

If you have a specific group in mind, I can work with it — just need the ID. But "show me all my groups" is blind spot territory. 🐟

segments.reasoningContent:
The user is asking if I can see their WhatsApp groups. Let me think about this...

Based on my tools, I don't have a direct "list all WhatsApp groups" tool. I have:
- `whatsapp_check` - to look up phone numbers
- `whatsapp_send` - to send messages to JIDs
- `whatsapp_send_image`, `whatsapp_send_document`, `whatsapp_send_audio` - media sending
- `whatsapp_reply` - to reply to messages
- `whatsapp_react` - react with emoji

There's no `whatsapp_list_groups` or similar tool. I can't enumerate the user's WhatsApp groups. I can only interact with groups if the user tells me the group ID/JID. 

So the honest answer is: no, I can't list your WhatsApp groups. I can only interact with specific groups if you give me their JID (the `@g.us` ID).
